review:
The Great Chicken Escape is a lighter, comic slot from 2019: a 3×5 grid with 20 paylines, following Charlie and his chicken gang as they try to break out of a farm camp. Pragmatic describes it as a story-led game rather than a high-volatility chase.

During play the gang can trigger random symbols or expanding wilds to help form wins. The escape itself runs through five bonus games, each building a stretch of tunnel, with payouts increasing as you progress. Pragmatic lists a 96.50% RTP and doesn't publish a max win on its page. Its official description is short, so the free demo is the best way to see how the five bonus stages play out.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
